annotations.title: Natural disasters and warnings in a country, a region or the world

description:
Natural disasters, hazards and official warnings in force across a country, a region or the whole world, from the same sources as get_hazards_near: wildfires, earthquakes, tsunami bulletins, tropical cyclones, floods, volcanic eruptions, droughts, official weather warnings (US National Weather Service, MeteoAlarm services across Europe) and air quality.

Use it for questions about an area rather than a point: what is happening in Japan, which red warnings are in force in Europe, the strongest earthquakes in the world this week. For what is near one place use get_hazards_near; for one country's long-term risk, get_country_profile.

Give country, or bbox for a region, or neither for the whole world. Every type, kind and severity is included unless event_types, kinds (occurrence, warning, status), min_severity or days narrow it. Returns the most severe events first and then the most recently active, limit of them; total and the counts by type, severity and kind cover every event that matched. A warning carries its issuer (sender), onset_at and expires_at; metadata holds the source's own facts, such as an earthquake's depth or a storm's wind. A country or a bbox holds an event by its point: a warning whose area reaches in from outside is not listed, and get_hazards_near answers for a place inside any area.

bbox.description: A region as [west, south, east, north] in degrees. A region across 180 gives its east past 180, at any width ([120, -50, 300, 30] runs from 120 east across the Pacific to 60 west); west above east also crosses 180, for a region less than half the world across
bbox.title: Bbox

country.description: Only events in this country or territory: its ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (e.g. JPN, PRI) or its English name
country.title: Country

days.description: Only events active in the last N days, 1 to 30; all current when omitted
days.title: Days

event_types.description: Only these types of event; every type when omitted
event_types.title: Event Types

kinds.description: Only occurrences, warnings or statuses; all of them when omitted
kinds.title: Kinds

min_severity.description: Only events at least this severe; every severity when omitted
min_severity.title: Min Severity

name: list_hazards

active_at.description: The latest moment the source reports it active
active_at.title: Active At

expires_at.description: When the source says it ends; null when it states none
expires_at.title: Expires At

issued_at.description: When the source issued this record
issued_at.title: Issued At

issuer_text.description: A warning's headline, description and instruction as the issuing service published them for the public, attributed to its sender. Null when the source gives none
issuer_text.title: Issuer Text

kind.description: occurrence (something happening), warning (an authority's message about an area) or status
kind.title: Kind

metadata.description: What the source says beyond the value. A USGS earthquake carries depth_km, magnitude_type, felt_reports (Did You Feel It? reports), cdi and mmi (felt and ShakeMap intensity), pager_alert and review_status; a NOAA tsunami bulletin its centre, magnitude, origin_time and depth_km; an NHC storm its max_wind_kt, pressure_mb and movement; a MeteoAlarm warning its awareness_level (yellow, orange, red) and awareness_type
metadata.title: Metadata

sender.description: The issuing authority, when the source relays many
sender.title: Sender

track.description: A moving event's positions, oldest first: kind observed where it was seen, forecast where the source expects it
track.title: Track

counts_by_kind.description: Every match, as occurrence, warning or status
counts_by_kind.title: Counts By Kind

data.description: The most severe first, then the most recently active
data.title: Data

total.description: Every event that matched; data lists the first of them
total.title: Total
